message:
The system has zlib and lzma but not UCL. UPX needs UCL for its compression. Let me check if I can install UCL or if there's another approach. Actually, let me think about this differently.

Instead of building UPX, I can create the packed file manually. The key insight is that I need to create compressed data that, when decompressed by UPX's `decompress` function, produces a valid ELF64 header with a large `e_phnum`.

Let me look at what compression methods UPX supports and how `decompress` works.

<｜｜DSML｜｜ode>

<function=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>grep -n "void PackLinuxElf64::decompress\|decompress(" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/src/p_lx_elf.cpp | head -10</｜｜DSML｜｜ode>

<function=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>grep -n "void PackLinuxElf64::decompress\|decompress(" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/src/p_lx_elf.cpp | head -10</｜｜DSML｜｜parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜ode>
